poster_title: ESSAYBENCH: Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese Essay Writing
authors: Fan Gao, Dongyuan Li, Ding Xia, Fei Mi, Yasheng Wang, Lifeng Shang, Baojun Wang
paper_info: The University of Tokyo, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, 2023

panels.headline: Addressing the gap in LLM capabilities for Chinese essay writing
content: Chinese essay writing is crucial in educational contexts.
LLM capabilities in this domain are underexplored.
Existing benchmarks lack fine-grained and genre-specific metrics.
Chinese essays have unique characteristics across genres.

panels.headline: Current evaluation methods are too coarse-grained
content: Current methods fail to capture genre-specific criteria.
They limit the ability to reflect nuanced demands of Chinese essay writing.
panels.figure_caption: Comparison of ESSAYBENCH with other benchmarks in terms of size, composition, and evaluations.

panels.headline: ESSAYBENCH covers four major genres and real-world scenarios
content: 728 real-world prompts are curated and categorized.
A fine-grained, genre-specific scoring framework is developed.
panels.figure_caption: Overview of the ESSAYBENCH dataset curation, representative prompts, and the evaluation framework.

panels.headline: Human agreement study and quality sensitivity analysis
content: A human agreement study is conducted to validate the protocol.
Quality sensitivity analysis is performed to test robustness.
panels.figure_caption: Comparison of human agreement evaluation across different scoring methods on sampled data.

panels.headline: ESSAYBENCH aligns closely with human judgments
content: The framework significantly improves the ability to distinguish essay quality.
Benchmarking results for 15 large-scale LLMs are provided.
panels.figure_caption: Benchmarking Results on Chinese Essay Writing. In each column, the highest and the second highest performance is highlighted in bold and is underlined.

panels.headline: ESSAYBENCH advances the evaluation of LLM-generated Chinese essays
content: The benchmark addresses genre-specific criteria and real-world scenarios.
The framework provides a more reliable and nuanced assessment of essay quality.
It inspires future research in Chinese essay writing and LLM evaluation.
